text: 原来我是比较传统的人，对卖淫嫖娼这种道德败坏的行为是深恶痛绝。
en: I used to be a fairly traditional person, and I had a deep hatred for the morally corrupt behaviour of prostitution and soliciting.

text: 但被社会上敲打了这么多年，加上女权主义的兴起，我对很多事产生了疑问，就拿嫖娼这事来说。
en: But after being knocked about by society for so many years, and with the rise of feminism, I have come to question many things — take soliciting prostitution as an example.

text: 首先，你觉得卖淫嫖娼有罪，那第一步就是要定义什么叫卖淫嫖娼，这样才能去抓人判刑。
en: First of all, if you think prostitution and soliciting is a crime, then the first step is to define what counts as prostitution and soliciting, so that you can arrest people and pass sentence.

text: 我觉得只要用性资源去换取利益，无论男女，都叫卖淫嫖娼。
en: I think that as long as one uses sexual resources to exchange for benefit, regardless of gender, it counts as prostitution and soliciting.

text: 而现实是，普通人花钱去找一个性工作者买春叫卖淫嫖娼，会受到法律的制裁，但是很多有钱有权有势的人，他们包养情妇，女大学生，却被算作道德问题，但明显他们的行为更恶劣。
en: And the reality is that an ordinary person who pays to find a sex worker to buy sex is called prostitution and soliciting and will be punished by law, but many wealthy, powerful and influential people who keep mistresses and female university students are treated as a moral issue, yet clearly their behaviour is far worse.

text: 再有，出轨，约炮这种不检点的行为跟嫖娼卖淫有什么区别吗？
en: Furthermore, is there any difference between behaviour like cheating and casual hook-ups and prostitution and soliciting?

text: 花几百几千一次算嫖娼，约炮送人几千的礼物难道就不算了吗？
en: Spending a few hundred or a few thousand per time counts as soliciting, but giving someone a gift worth thousands for a casual hook-up doesn't count?

text: 更过分的是彩礼，本来彩礼这种东西就是旧社会的产物，哪怕在二十年前，彩礼也只是结婚的添头，也从来没听说过因为彩礼问题谈不拢导致婚姻破裂的。
en: Even more excessive is the bride price. This kind of thing is originally a product of the old society; even twenty years ago, the bride price was merely an add-on to marriage, and one never heard of a marriage falling apart because the bride price could not be agreed upon.

text: 但现在，你去看看所有网络平台，女性对彩礼的评价已经从添头变为必需品，数量越来越离谱不说，合法性也在变相的被官方承认。
en: But now, if you look at all the online platforms, women's evaluations of the bride price have changed from an add-on to a necessity; not only are the amounts becoming more and more absurd, but its legitimacy is also being tacitly acknowledged by the authorities.

text: 很多女性甚至直接说出男性不给彩礼就是白嫖，那好，照这个说法，那给了彩礼是不是算嫖娼？
en: Many women even openly say that if a man does not give a bride price it is free-riding, so well, by that logic, does giving a bride price count as soliciting?

text: 彩礼是不是嫖资？
en: Is the bride price payment for sex?

text: 这人证物证俱全的卖淫嫖娼行为，却不犯法。
en: This act of prostitution and soliciting, with witnesses and material evidence, is nonetheless not illegal.

text: 而且根据已经出台的法律文件和过往案例，离婚退彩礼是按照同居时间来确定返还比例，时间越长退的越少，如果超一年，彩礼就一分不退了。
en: Moreover, according to existing legal documents and past cases, the return of the bride price upon divorce is determined by the duration of cohabitation — the longer the time, the less is returned; if it exceeds a year, not a penny of the bride price is returned.

text: 那我可不可以理解为这是官方在保护嫖资？
en: So may I understand this as the authorities protecting payment for sex?

text: 你说卖淫嫖娼危害社会治安，逼良为娼。
en: You say prostitution and soliciting endangers public order and forces decent women into prostitution.

text: 但事实是绝大多数卖淫女是自愿的，而且她们大多数不是走投无路，而是因为利益太大来钱太快，很多人甚至通过卖淫挣出来她正常工作无数倍的收入。
en: But the truth is that the vast majority of prostitutes are voluntary, and most of them are not driven to desperation, but because the profit is huge and the money comes fast; many even earn through prostitution incomes many times what they would in normal work.

text: 就拿骗婚来说，已经成流水线了，有很多女性通过闪婚骗彩礼离婚这个流水线轻松挣了七位数不止，而官方对此惩罚力度明显不够，大多数和稀泥了事，最严重的处罚也就是逼着女方退彩礼，没有任何刑事处罚。
en: Take marriage fraud as an example — it has become an assembly line. Many women easily earn seven figures or more through the assembly line of flash marriage, defrauding the bride price, and divorce, while the authorities' punishment for this is clearly insufficient; most cases are fudged and left at that, and the harshest penalty is simply forcing the woman to return the bride price, with no criminal punishment whatsoever.

text: 骗到了能挣到真金白银，骗不到也没有任何损失，合着这是鼓励女性都去犯罪吗？
en: If you succeed in the fraud you earn real money, and if you fail there is no loss at all — so is this encouraging women to commit crimes?

text: 直到现在，我仍然觉得卖淫嫖娼不应该合法，但是如果放任现在这种情况，已经是名存实亡了。
en: Even now, I still think prostitution and soliciting should not be legal, but if the current situation is allowed to continue unchecked, it is already a mere formality in name only.

text: 有兴趣的话去观察一下大学生，很多的二本三本大专的女性已经在偷着接私活了，一人能带着一群人堕落，而且这个趋势在向名牌大学扩散。
en: If you are interested, go and observe university students — many women at second-tier, third-tier and vocational colleges are already secretly taking on private work; one person can lead a whole group into degradation, and this trend is spreading towards prestigious universities.

text: 如果官方在不出手制止，出台政策，社会会像日本那样，风俗业大行其道甚至成为很多女性唯一的就业渠道，那我们这个问题也就根本没有讨论的意义了。
en: If the authorities do not step in to stop it and introduce policies, society will be like Japan, where the sex industry flourishes and even becomes the only employment channel for many women, and then there would be no point at all in discussing this issue.

text: 近两年网络上关于“色情合法化”的讨论，本质上是对勃列日涅夫75年后实行的“文化禁欲政策”感到愤怒和不满。
en: In recent years, online discussions about the 'legalisation of pornography' are essentially anger and dissatisfaction towards the 'cultural abstinence policy' implemented by Brezhnev after 1975.

text: 从而摆出一副“毁灭吧，赶紧自由化”的态度
en: Thus putting on an attitude of 'let it be destroyed, hurry up and liberalise'.

text: 笔者过去有一条热门回答，很多人点赞（亦或是评论？
en: The author once had a popular answer that many people liked (or was it comments?

text: 很久以前的事情了，我忘记了），主旨就是反对性交易合法化。
en: It was a long time ago and I have forgotten), and the main point was opposition to the legalisation of sex trade.

text: 但近年猖獗的各类案例，已经让笔者在反思先前的观点了。
en: But various cases rampant in recent years have already led the author to reflect on previous views.

text: “19岁小伙被女友10万元卖到缅甸”，律师解读:女孩可被认定诈骗罪共犯，我国刑法尚无拐卖男性罪名
en: '19-year-old young man sold by girlfriend to Myanmar for 100,000 yuan': lawyer's interpretation: the girl may be identified as an accomplice to fraud; China's criminal law still has no offence of trafficking men.

text: 即使从双标的角度来看，很多观点都站不住脚，已经把拉偏架摆在脸上了。
en: Even from the perspective of double standards, many arguments do not hold water, and the favouritism has already been laid bare.

text: 然而事实上，已经半合法化了。
en: Yet in fact, it is already semi-legalised.

text: 目前应该做的是亡羊补牢，减少因为卖淫带来的社会问题——性渠道传染病。
en: What should be done at present is to take remedial action to reduce the social problems brought by prostitution: sexually transmitted infectious diseases.

text: 方法很简单：将健康码系统恢复并改造。
en: The method is simple: restore and upgrade the health code system.

text: 想要约的、嫖的、卖的、多人的，都需要出示自己的绿码。
en: Those who want to hook up, solicit, sell, or have group sex all need to show their green code.

text: 有淋病、梅毒、艾滋的，二维码变色，直到恢复健康。
en: Those with gonorrhoea, syphilis, or AIDS have their QR code change colour until they recover their health.

text: 该项目通过官方微信小程序进行扫码确认，截图、伪造无效。
en: The project confirms via scanning through the official WeChat mini-program; screenshots and forgeries are invalid.

text: 双方do前，自行扫码监督对方。
en: Before the two parties do it, they scan each other's code to supervise one another.

text: 二维码异常的，或无法出示二维码的，由另一方自行决定是否继续。
en: Those with abnormal QR codes, or who cannot show a QR code, leave it to the other party to decide whether to continue.

text: 补充下规则：1个月内检测健康，绿码；不参与检测或检测过期的，显示灰码；如果你扫过的绿码从绿变红了，你的码变黄。
en: Supplementary rules: those tested healthy within one month get a green code; those who do not take the test or whose test has expired show a grey code; if a green code you scanned turns from green to red, your code turns yellow.

text: 你以为卖淫后自己是游走在花丛间一掷千金的客人
en: You think that after soliciting you are a guest strolling among the flowers, spending money lavishly,

text: 实际上你也是等待挑选的商品
en: but in fact you are also a commodity waiting to be chosen.

text: 德国、荷兰、瑞士、新西兰、希腊、澳大利亚部分地区完全允许卖淫
en: Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, New Zealand, Greece, and parts of Australia fully permit prostitution.

text: 英国、西班牙、比利时允许个人卖淫
en: Britain, Spain, and Belgium permit individual prostitution.

text: 法国、挪威、冰岛、瑞典、加拿大卖淫合法但是嫖娼违法
en: France, Norway, Iceland, Sweden, and Canada: prostitution is legal but soliciting is illegal.

text: 美国部分地区合法
en: Parts of the United States are legal.

text: 总体来说，不合法的地区都不够“文明”
en: Overall, the regions where it is illegal are all insufficiently 'civilised'.

text: 反驳不了，卖淫合法会让世界变得更好，阻拦只不过是心理作祟罢了。
en: It cannot be refuted that legalising prostitution makes the world better; obstructing it is merely a psychological hang-up.

text: 第一个优点是合法化以后，能控制传染病得传播。
en: The first advantage is that after legalisation, the spread of infectious diseases can be controlled.

text: 第二个优点是能减少强奸案的发生。
en: The second advantage is that it can reduce the occurrence of rape cases.

text: 第三个优点是能促进消费，让男女收入更平衡。
en: The third advantage is that it can promote consumption and make the income of men and women more balanced.

text: 第4个优点是优化婚姻观念，减少家暴等事件的发生。
en: The fourth advantage is optimising marriage attitudes and reducing the occurrence of events such as domestic violence.

text: 至于什么拐卖人口就是扯，正规机构交五险一金，一份职业而已，怎么拐卖。
en: As for claims that human trafficking is involved, that is nonsense — proper institutions pay five insurances and one housing fund; it is just a profession, how could there be trafficking.

text: 这个问题很简单：法律、政策，从来都是与经济状况、意识形态等客观环境配套的，没有一定可以或一定不可以这回事。
en: This question is simple: laws and policies have always been matched with objective environments such as economic conditions and ideology; there is no such thing as absolutely can or absolutely cannot.

text: so，按照现代公民社会伦理，卖淫合法化的前提是该社会对性祛魅，有什么样的文化基础，有搞什么样的政策。
en: So, according to the ethics of a modern civil society, the premise of legalising prostitution is that society demystifies sex; what kind of cultural foundation there is determines what kind of policy is made.

text: 有些民族对贞操观看得比较淡，卖淫是可以接受的风俗业，合法化是可以具备自我约束条件的。
en: Some peoples view chastity relatively lightly; prostitution is an acceptable custom industry, and legalisation can have conditions for self-restraint.

text: 有些民族对贞操观看得很重，卖淫是罪大恶极，强行合法化，只会导致失控性的基层秩序崩盘。
en: Some peoples regard chastity very highly; prostitution is an abomination, and forced legalisation would only lead to a loss of control and the collapse of grassroots order.

text: 还是那句话，你想让一个东西别那么贵，前提是你别觉得这个东西多神圣。
en: As the saying goes, if you want something not to be so expensive, the premise is that you do not regard it as so sacred.

text: 你都觉得这东西非常重要非常宝贵了，它能便宜得了吗？
en: You already think this thing is very important and very precious, so how could it be cheap?

text: 又要鼓吹贞操观，又要廉价性资源，只能说梦里啥都有了。
en: Wanting to preach chastity values while also wanting cheap sexual resources — one can only say everything is there in dreams.
